edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the mint account in the SimpleERC20 constructor.
initialBalance_ parameter flows into _mint as the minted amount.
name_ constructor parameter is assigned to _name.
symbol_ constructor parameter is assigned to _symbol.
feeReceiver_ parameter is cast to IPayable and used as the external call receiver.
ServicePayer constructor executes the payable pay external call.
SimpleERC20 constructor invokes _mint to create the initial supply.
SimpleERC20 constructor delegates to the ServicePayer constructor.
_mint increases _totalSupply by amount.
_totalSupply += amount is the supply addition operation.
_mint credits _balances[account] with the minted amount.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before state updates.
_transfer mutates _balances for both sender and recipient.
_transfer computes senderBalance - amount.
Cached senderBalance local is the minuend of the subtraction.
sender parameter indexes _balances to produce senderBalance.
amount parameter is used in the balance updates and event.
recipient parameter receives the transferred amount.
_transfer calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before updating state.
transferFrom delegates the actual movement to _transfer.
transferFrom reads the current allowance into a local variable.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance.
amount parameter is forwarded by transferFrom.
transfer forwards to _transfer.
transfer uses _msgSender derived from msg.sender as the source of funds.
approve forwards to _approve.
approve sets allowance for the caller from msg.sender.
increaseAllowance forwards to _approve.
increaseAllowance reads and writes _allowances.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender as the allowance owner.
decreaseAllowance caches the caller allowance in a local variable.
decreaseAllowance computes currentAllowance - subtractedValue.
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the reduced allowance.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances.
_burn reduces _balances[account] by amount.
_burn reduces _totalSupply by amount.
_burn caches account balance into a local variable.
_burn calls the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before state updates.
_msgSender returns msg.sender as the trusted context sender.
The constructor mint path resolves the caller through _msgSender.

normalization_plan.reason: Local allowance cache exists only to serve the transferFrom allowance check and reduction.
Local sender balance is an intermediate read of _balances used by the transfer subtraction.
Local burn balance is an intermediate read of _balances used by the burn subtraction.
Local allowance cache is used solely for the decrease guard and subtraction.
Initial balance parameter flows directly into the _mint amount.
Name parameter is consumed only by the constructor assignment to _name.
Symbol parameter is consumed only by the constructor assignment to _symbol.
Fee receiver parameter is forwarded to the ServicePayer external pay call.
Amount parameter drives the balance mutation and Transfer event in _transfer.
Recipient parameter is the credit target of the internal transfer.
Sender parameter is the debit source of the internal transfer.
Amount parameter is forwarded to the underlying _transfer call.
